Office Building Loans

Underwriting

What we look at on a office loan

  • The tenant roster and lease rollover over the next few years
  • The tenant improvements and leasing commissions needed to fill vacant space
  • Building condition, parking and mechanical systems
  • Local office demand and vacancy
  • Your plan if a major tenant leaves
Scenarios

Common office deals we see

  • A medical practice buying its own office building
  • Buying a partially vacant suburban office building to re-lease
  • Refinancing a fully leased professional building
Office loan FAQ

Common questions about office loans.

Do you finance medical office buildings?

Yes. Medical and professional office buildings are reviewed case by case, for investors and for owner-occupiers.

Can a business buy its own office building with an SLA Capital loan?

Yes. Owner-occupied commercial is eligible: a business can buy or refinance the building it operates from.

Do you lend on partially vacant office buildings?

Yes, typically with a commercial bridge loan. We look at your leasing plan, the cost to fill the space and the local market.

What loan sizes are available for office buildings?

Commercial bridge loans up to $20,000,000 and commercial DSCR loans up to $3,000,000, each reviewed and priced case by case.
